name: Republic of El Salvador
method: official census-based estimate corrected and backdated
locator: Diario Oficial, vol. 51, no. 164, 13 July 1901, printed p. 1314 (PDF p. 91), Resumen del censo de 1901, La República row and introduction.
definition: Official adjusted national population at 1 January 1901. The statistics directorate corrected the 1 March 1901 enumeration using other documents and backdated the results to January. It gives no correction magnitude or raw March total. The 14 department totals and the two national sex totals each sum to the headline. Exact opening map boundaries are unresolved.
